t: What he said after gathering them under a cloak
a: اللَّهُمَّ هَؤُلاَءِ أَهْلُ بَيْتِي فَأَذْهِبْ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَطَهِّرْهُمْ تَطْهِيرًا
p: Allāhumma hāʾulāʾi ahlu baytī fa-adhhib ʿanhumu-r-rijsa wa ṭahhirhum taṭhīrā
m: O Allah, these are the people of my house. Remove impurity from them and purify them completely.
